baseline_method: Human visual transcription and semantic acceptance criteria written before running Nskry OCR/translation. Do not replace the baseline with program output.

metrics.ocr: Report whitespace-insensitive, case/punctuation-sensitive character edit distance and CER, plus exact Han/Latin/digit content. Text outside the main readable sign is not part of its reference; extra OCR text is still reported.
metrics.translation: Reference wording is illustrative, not exact-match output. Manually check every meaning unit, role assignment, repetitions, proper names and numbers; keyword/regex hits are diagnostic only, not proof of correct translation.

fixtures.conversion: TIFF decoded and saved as lossless PNG with Windows System.Drawing; no crop, rescale, sharpening or text replacement.
fixtures.expected_source:

ocr code and see if it works on all types

lazy fox. The quick brown dog jumped

jumped over the lazy fox. The quick

fixtures.reference_translation:
这是一大段12磅字号的文字，用来测试OCR代码，看看它是否适用于所有类型的文件格式。
敏捷的棕色狗跳过了懒狐狸。敏捷的棕色狗跳过了懒狐狸。敏捷的棕色狗跳过了懒狐狸。敏捷的棕色狗跳过了懒狐狸。
meaning_units: 12 point refers to font size, not twelve separate passages, points or words.
The text tests OCR code and whether it works on all file-format types.
A quick brown DOG jumps over a lazy FOX, not the familiar reversed pangram.
The dog/fox event occurs four times in the source; do not silently omit repetitions.
Soft visual line wraps must not turn the same sentence into unrelated fragments.

fixtures.conversion: Original public JPEG; no image changes. No PaddleOCR engine is installed or used by this test.

fixtures.scope: The four large readable text rows on the green direction sign. Arrows and tiny partial background text are excluded from the text reference; no inference from a brand dictionary is required.
meaning_units: First entity is a Shanghai hotel; preserving its Chinese proper name or a reasonable transliteration is acceptable, inventing a different hotel is not.
The hotel address is number 15, Dapu Road.
Second entity is a garden-apartment property; proper-name spelling may vary but its identity/type must not be replaced.
The apartment addresses include ALL of 25, 29 and 35, Dapu Road.
Keep both properties and the correct address-to-property association; do not hallucinate text from the foliage.
